observation: Front, top and iso inspected together as one contact sheet at 500 px a view. Thin rectangular slab ruled into cells by shallow grooves, with the deeper terrain pockets sunk in its own quadrant. Front view is one even slab of constant thickness; iso shows the grooves as grooves and the pockets as pockets, with a full-width rib left between every pair. Nothing floating, no pocket broken through the underside, no cell missing its rib.
